title: 2024 VALORANT Champions Opening Ceremony
overview: .Relive the 2024 VALORANT Champions Grand Finals Opening Ceremony in Seoul presented by Mastercard featuring a live performance of the 2024 anthem ‘SUPERPOWER’ by Mark Tuan and Natty and Julie from KISS OF LIFE, RUN! By Odetari and Lay Bankz and 2 WORLDS by Madge.
